blocks.text: Sahara (support) aur harkat (movement) insani biology ke bunyadi pehlu hain. In hi ki wajah se hum seedhe chalne phirne se le kar mushkil kaamon tak bohat si sargarmiyan kar sakte hain. Is chapter mein haddiyon (bones) aur cartilage ki banawat parhenge, jo jism ko zaroori sahara dene wala dhancha (framework) deti hain. Hum mukhtalif qism ke jor (joints) dekhenge, aur teen qism ke muscles (pathon), yani skeletal, smooth aur cardiac, ki khaas baatein dekhenge jo harkat paida karte hain. Muscle ke sukarne ko molecule ki satah par samajhne ke liye sliding filament model parhenge. Is ke ilawa skeletal aur muscular systems ki aam bimariyan aur insani sehat aur chalne phirne par un ka asar bhi dekhenge.

Haddiyan, cartilage aur doosre connective tissues (jorne wale tissues) mil kar jism ke andar ek dhancha banate hain jise skeleton kehte hain. Skeleton jism ko sahara deta hai, ahem aza (organs) ki hifazat karta hai, aur harkat aur chalne phirne (locomotion) mein madad deta hai.
Haddi ki banawat (Structure of Bone)

Haddiyan connective tissue se bani hain jise calcium aur khaas bone cells ne mazboot banaya hota hai. Haddi ki satah ek sakht jhilli (membrane) se dhaki hoti hai jise periosteum kehte hain. Periosteum ke neeche sakht maadde ki moti tah hoti hai jise compact bone kehte hain. Haddi ka zyada tar tissue yahi hai (Fig. 12.1). Compact bone ki bunyadi ikaiyan (units) Haversian systems kehlati hain. Ek Haversian system in cheezon se banta hai:

items: Lamellae: yeh extracellular matrix (cells ke bahar ka maadda) ki gol, ek doosre ke andar tahein (concentric layers) hain jin mein minerals jame hote hain. In mein collagen fibres aur calcium phosphate ke chhote, sui jaise crystals hote hain. Crystals bhurbhure (brittle) magar sakht hote hain aur haddi ko bohat mazbooti dete hain. Collagen lachakdar magar kamzor hota hai. Is tarah haddi mazboot bhi hai aur lachakdar bhi.

Lacunae aur osteocytes: lamellae ke beech chhoti chhoti khali jagahein hoti hain jinhen lacunae kehte hain. Osteocytes, yani pakke (mature) bone cells, in lacunae mein rehte hain. Osteocytes aapas mein aur Haversian canal se bareek naliyon ke zariye jure hote hain jinhen canaliculi kehte hain.
Haversian canal: lamellae ki gol tahein beech ki ek nali ko gherti hain jise Haversian canal kehte hain. Is mein khoon ki naliyan, nerves aur lymph ki naliyan hoti hain.

blocks.text: In ke ilawa kuch chhoti naliyan Haversian canals ke amudi (perpendicular, 90 darje par) chalti hain aur unhen aapas mein aur periosteum se jorti hain. In mein bhi khoon ki naliyan, nerves aur lymph ki naliyan hoti hain. Collagen fibres periosteum ko neeche wali haddi se mazbooti se bandh dete hain, jis se haddi ko mazeed mazbooti aur thehrao milta hai.

Compact bone ke neeche spongy bone hoti hai (Fig. 12.1). Is ki banawat jaali (latticework) jaisi hai jo haddi ke nukeele tukron (bony spikes) se bani hoti hai; is wajah se yeh halki bhi hai aur mazboot bhi.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Haddi ke chaure sire epiphysis kehlate hain aur lambai mein beech ka hissa diaphysis ya shaft kehlata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen jure hue khaake. Baen: ek lambi haddi jis par epiphysis, diaphysis aur epiphysis ke brackets hain; siron mein spongy bone hai, shaft ki deewar compact bone ki hai jo bone marrow ko gherti hai, aur satah par periosteum hai. Darmiyan: shaft ki deewar ka bara kiya hua tukra, ek taraf spongy bone aur doosri taraf Haversian systems se bani compact bone; har system Haversian canal ke gird lamellae ke halqon (rings) ka hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.1: Haddi ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 12.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Teen jure hue khaake. Baen: ek lambi haddi jis par epiphysis, diaphysis aur epiphysis ke brackets hain; siron mein spongy bone hai, shaft ki deewar compact bone ki hai jo bone marrow ko gherti hai, aur satah par periosteum hai. Darmiyan: shaft ki deewar ka bara kiya hua tukra, ek taraf spongy bone aur doosri taraf Haversian systems se bani compact bone; har system Haversian canal ke gird lamellae ke halqon (rings) ka hai. Daen: ek Haversian system ka chautha hissa jis mein lacunae ke andar osteocytes hain jo canaliculi se jure hain, extracellular matrix ke beech.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen se daen parhein: poori haddi, phir us ki deewar ka tukra, phir ek Haversian system. Lambi haddi ke siron (epiphysis) mein jaali jaisi spongy bone hai aur beech ke shaft (diaphysis) ki deewar thos compact bone ki. Compact bone Haversian systems ki bani hai: beech mein canal (khoon ki naliyan aur asaab) aur us ke gird lamellae ke halqe. Halqon ke darmiyan lacunae mein osteocytes rehte hain, aur barik canaliculi unhein aapas mein aur canal se jorti hain taake ghiza pohanch sake.
Bone marrow (haddi ka gooda)

Bohat si haddiyon mein ek naram tissue hota hai jise bone marrow (gooda) kehte hain; yeh laal (red) ya peela (yellow) ho sakta hai. Red bone marrow spongy bone, lambi haddiyon ke siron, pasliyon, vertebrae, sternum aur pelvis mein hota hai. Yeh red blood cells, platelets aur white blood cells banata hai. Yellow bone marrow lambi haddiyon ke shaft ko bharta hai. Yeh zyada tar charbi (fat) ke cells se bana hai aur energy ke zakhire ka kaam karta hai. Agar bohat zyada khoon beh jaye to yellow marrow red marrow mein badal kar khoon ke cells bhi bana sakta hai.
Bone cells ki qismein (Types of Bone Cells)
Haddiyon ke banne, barhne aur nayi banawat (remodelling) mein teen qism ke cells kaam karte hain: osteoblasts, osteocytes aur osteoclasts.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text:
Itni zyada tadaad aur size ke bawajood haddiyan jism ke wazan (mass) ka 20% se kam hain.
Haddiyan sookhi aur bejaan nahin, jaisi nazar aati hain; yeh geeli (moist) aur zinda tissues hain.

Osteoblasts haddi banane wale cells hain. Yeh ground substance (matrix ka bunyadi maadda) banate aur nikalte hain jis mein abhi minerals nahin hote. Jab osteoblasts matrix mein ghir jate hain to osteocytes ban jate hain.

Osteocytes pakke bone cells hain. Yeh enzymes aur haddi ke minerals nikal kar haddi ke tissue ko sehatmand rakhte hain. Yeh haddi se khoon mein calcium jane ki miqdar bhi control karte hain. Osteoclasts macrophages se bante hain aur bone resorption karte hain, yani haddi ko torte hain aur calcium aur phosphate khoon mein chhorte hain. Haddi ke barhne aur marammat (repair) ke liye osteoclasts ka kaam zaroori hai.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure haddi ke cells ki qatar: tissue ki tah ke neeche osteogenic cell (stem cell), phir bone matrix ke neeche osteoblasts ki qatar (bone matrix banate hain), phir shakhon wala osteocyte (pukhta haddi ka cell); saath haddi ki satah par kai nuclei wala bara osteoclast (haddi ko ghulata hai).
blocks.caption: Figure 12.2: Haddi ke cells ki qismein (kitab ki Figure 12.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer nashonuma ka rasta dikhate hain: osteogenic stem cell se osteoblasts bante hain, jo matrix bana kar khud us mein qaid ho jate hain aur osteocytes ban jate hain. Osteoclast is raste ka hissa nahin; yeh kai nuclei wala bara cell hai jo purani haddi ko tor kar (resorb) remodelling mein madad deta hai.
Haddi ka banna (Bone Development)

Haddi banne ke amal ko osteogenesis kehte hain. Yeh janeen (embryo) ki nashonuma mein shuru hota hai aur saari zindagi jari rehta hai; haddiyon ke barhne, qaim rehne aur marammat mein is ka bara kirdar hai. Osteogenesis ke do bunyadi raste hain.

blocks.title: Remodelling
blocks.text: Haddiyan poori ban jane ke baad bhi osteogenesis bone remodelling ki shakal mein jari rehti hai. Is musalsal amal mein osteoclasts purani haddi torte hain aur osteoblasts nayi haddi banate hain.

items: Lambi haddiyan, maslan femur (raan ki haddi) aur humerus (bazu ki haddi), cartilage ke haddi mein badalne se banti hain. Pehle cartilage ka beech ka hissa sakht (calcify) hota hai aur wahan ke chondrocytes (cartilage cells) mar kar khali jagahen (cavities) chhor jate hain. Khoon ki naliyan in jagahon mein osteoblasts aur osteoclasts le aati hain. Osteoblasts (haddi banane wale cells) cartilage ki jagah nayi haddi banate hain. Minerals jamne se cartilage ka haddi banna ossification kehlata hai (Fig. 12.3). Osteoclasts (haddi torne wale cells) sakht cartilage tor kar nayi haddi ke liye jagah banate hain. Haddi pakne par kuch osteoblasts haddi mein qaid ho kar osteocytes (pakke bone cells) ban jate hain jo haddi ko qaim rakhte hain. Yeh amal tab tak chalta hai jab tak saari cartilage haddi na ban jaye; sirf joron ki satah (articular surfaces) par kuch cartilage baqi rehti hai.

Kuch haddiyan, maslan khopri (skull) ki kuch haddiyan, pehle cartilage banaye baghair seedhi sakht haddi ban jati hain. In mein shuru mein cells janeen ke connective tissue mein be-tarteeb bikhre hote hain, phir jald hi tahon (layers) mein jur kar haddi ki chapti plates ban jati hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab is doosre raste mein “osteocytes” likhti hai. Asal mein shuru mein mesenchyme (janeen ka connective tissue) ke cells osteoblasts bante hain; yeh matrix banate hain aur us mein qaid ho kar osteocytes bante hain. Haddi ki chhoti chhoti patten (trabeculae) aapas mein jur kar chapti plates banati hain.

blocks.alt: Lambi haddi ke paanch marhale, teeron se jure aur barhte hue: cartilage ka model; shaft ke beech ossification ki pehli jagah; shaft mein phailti haddi aur marrow cavity mein khoon ki naliyan; ek sire mein ossification ki doosri jagah; aur poori haddi jis ke siron par sirf articular cartilage bachti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.3: Cartilage se haddi ki nashonuma (kitab ki Figure 12.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neela rang cartilage hai aur peela haddi. Pehle poora dhancha cartilage ka hota hai; phir shaft ke beech haddi banna shuru hoti hai (first site). Khoon ki naliyan andar aati hain aur gooda (marrow) ki jagah banti hai. Baad mein siron mein doosri jagah (second site) se haddi banti hai. Aakhir mein sirf joron ki satah par articular cartilage reh jati hai.
Cartilage ki banawat (Structure of Cartilage)

Jaisa pichhle paragraph mein bataya, janeen (foetus) ki zyada tar cartilage haddi mein badal jati hai. Lekin kuch cartilage saari zindagi baqi rehti hai aur lachak (flexibility) deti hai, maslan haddiyon ke beech, naak ke sire par, bahar ke kaan mein aur trachea (saans ki nali) ke andar.

Cartilage ke gird connective tissue ki ek tah hoti hai jise perichondrium kehte hain. Is mein khoon ki naliyan, lymph ki naliyan aur nerves hoti hain jo cartilage ko ghiza aur signals pohanchati hain. Perichondrium ke andar cartilage matrix hai jo collagen, elastin, proteoglycans aur doosre fibres se bana hai. Yeh cartilage ko mazbooti, lachak aur dabne se bachne ki taqat deta hai. Doosre connective tissues ke ulat cartilage matrix ke andar khoon ki naliyan nahin hotin. Cartilage ke cells ko ghiza diffusion (phail kar pohanchne) se milti hai. Isi wajah se cartilage bohat aahista theek hoti hai.

Cartilage ke cells chondrocytes kehlate hain. Yeh chhoti khali jagahon, lacunae, mein hote hain jo cartilage matrix mein dhansi hoti hain. Chondrocytes cartilage ka matrix banate aur qaim rakhte hain (Fig. 12.4).
Cartilage ki qismein (Cartilage Types)

Cartilage teen qism ki hoti hai. Hyaline cartilage sab se aam hai; yeh naak, trachea aur joron mein haddiyon ki milne wali satah par hoti hai. Fibrocartilage jism ki un jagahon par hoti hai jahan bohat dabao aur khinchao (stress aur tension) hota hai, maslan intervertebral discs (vertebrae ke beech ki gaddiyan) aur pubic symphysis. Elastic cartilage bahar ke kaan aur epiglottis mein hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Cartilage ke teen blocks, har ek ke upar gulabi perichondrium ki tah: hyaline cartilage jis mein lacunae ke andar chondrocytes kam reshon wali sada matrix mein phaile hain; fibrocartilage jis mein ghane mutawazi collagen reshon ke beech kam chondrocytes hain; elastic cartilage jis mein bikhre chhote reshon ke beech bohat se chondrocytes hain. Labels: Chondrocytes in lacunae, Matrix, Collagen fibres, Perichondrium, Hyaline cartilage, Fibrocartilage, Elastic cartilage.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.4: Cartilage ki qismein (kitab ki Figure 12.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon mein woh hi cheezein hain: upar perichondrium, andar matrix, aur lacunae mein chondrocytes. Farq reshon mein hai: hyaline mein reshe kam aur matrix sheeshe jaisi, fibrocartilage mein ghane collagen reshe (mazbooti, jaise discs mein), elastic mein elastic reshe (lachak, jaise kaan ki lau mein).

rows: Calcium ke qalm aur collagen reshe
Zindagi bhar barhti aur khud marammat karti hai

blocks.text: Skeleton mein haddiyon ki tarteeb
Insan ke skeletal system mein 206 haddiyan hain. Skeleton ke do bare hisse hain: axial skeleton aur appendicular skeleton (Fig. 12.5).

blocks.alt: Jism ke khaake ke andar poore skeleton ka saamne ka manzar; axial haddiyan neeli aur appendicular gulabi. Daen axial labels: Cranium aur Facial bones (Skull), Middle ear Ossicles, Neck bone (Hyoid), Chest bone (Sternum), Ribs, Vertebral column. Baen appendicular labels: Pectoral girdle, Humerus, Ulna, Radius, Pelvic girdle, Carpals, Metacarpals, Phalanges, Femur, Patella, Tibia, Fibula, Tarsals, Metatarsals, Phalanges.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.5: Insani skeleton (kitab ki Figure 12.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeli haddiyan jism ka mehwar (axis) hain: khopri, reerh ki haddi, pasliyan aur seene ki haddi; yeh dimagh, dil aur phephron ki hifazat karti hain. Gulabi haddiyan bazu, taangein aur un ko jorne wale girdles hain; yeh harkat ke liye hain.
Axial skeleton

Axial skeleton jism ka mehwar (axis, beech ki lakeer) banata hai. Is ki haddiyan sar, gardan aur seene ke aza ko sahara deti aur un ki hifazat karti hain. Is mein khopri (skull), pasliyan (ribs), reerh ki haddi (spine) aur sternum (seene ki haddi) shamil hain.
a- Khopri (Skull): is mein yeh 22 haddiyan hain.

items: Aath cranial bones mil kar cranium (dimagh ka dabba) banati hain. 2 jori (paired) haddiyan parietal aur temporal hain. 4 akeli (unpaired) haddiyan frontal, occipital, ethmoid aur sphenoid hain.

Chaudah facial bones (chehre ki haddiyan) cranium se juri hain. 6 jori haddiyan lacrimal, zygomatic, nasal, inferior nasal concha, maxilla aur palatine hain. 2 akeli haddiyan mandible (jabre ki haddi) aur vomer hain.

blocks.alt: Khopri ke do manzar, har haddi apne rang mein. Pehlu ka manzar: Frontal, Parietal (2), Temporal (2), Occipital, Sphenoid, Ethmoid, Nasal (2), Lacrimal (2), Zygomatic (2), Maxilla (2) aur Mandible, jabra temporal haddi par jura hua. Saamne ka manzar chehre ki haddiyon ke liye: Nasal (2), Lacrimal (2), Inferior nasal concha (2), Maxilla (2), Mandible, Palatine (2), Zygomatic (2) aur Vomer.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.6: Insani khopri (kitab ki Figure 12.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (2) ka matlab hai ke yeh haddi jore mein hai, ek daen aur ek baen. Pehlu ke manzar mein cranium ki aath haddiyan (frontal, do parietal, do temporal, occipital, sphenoid, ethmoid) dimagh ko gherti hain. Saamne ka manzar chehre ki 14 haddiyan dikhata hai; palatine munh ki chhat ke peechhe hai, is liye nuqtedar lakeer se dikhai gayi hai. Neeche ka jabra (mandible) khopri ki akeli harkat karne wali haddi hai.
b- Middle ear (darmiyani kaan): dono darmiyani kaanon mein 6 haddiyan (3 jore) hain. Inhen ossicles kehte hain: malleus, incus aur stapes.

blocks.alt: Kaan ki kaat jis par external ear, middle ear aur internal ear ke brackets hain. Kaan ki nali eardrum par khatam hoti hai; malleus eardrum ko chhoota hai, incus darmiyan mein hai, aur stapes ka paon internal ear ki oval window mein betha hai. Teer teenon haddiyon ke bare manzar tak jata hai: Malleus, Incus, Stapes.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.7: Darmiyani kaan ki haddiyan (ossicles) (kitab ki Figure 12.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen chhoti haddiyan ek zanjeer hain: eardrum ki thartharahat malleus se incus aur phir stapes tak jati hai, aur stapes use oval window ke zariye andaruni kaan tak pohanchata hai. Har kaan mein yeh teen haddiyan hain, is liye dono kaanon mein chhe.
c- Gardan ki haddi (Neck bone): hyoid ek chhoti akeli haddi hai jo khopri ki jar mein zaban ke neeche hoti hai. Yeh sar ki kisi doosri haddi se nahin jurti.
d- Reerh ki haddi (Vertebral column): is mein 33 haddiyan hain jinhen vertebrae kehte hain. Vertebrae ke paanch group hain:

items: Saat cervical vertebrae: yeh gardan ke vertebrae hain. Pehle ko atlas aur doosre ko axis kehte hain.
Barah thoracic vertebrae: in se pasliyan juri hoti hain aur yeh seene ke hisse mein hain.
Paanch lumbar vertebrae: yeh pait (kamar ke nichle hisse) mein hain.
Paanch sacral vertebrae: yeh paanch aapas mein jure hue (fused) vertebrae hain jo sacrum banate hain. Sacrum koolhe ki iliac haddiyon se jur kar pelvis ka pichla hissa banata hai.
Chaar coccygeal vertebrae ya coccyx: baligh insan mein yeh aapas mein jure hote hain. Sacral aur coccygeal vertebrae ko mila kar pelvic vertebrae kehte hain.

blocks.text: e- Pasliyon ka pinjra aur seene ki haddi (Rib Cage & Chest bone): rib cage mein 24 haddiyan (12 jore) hain jinhen ribs (pasliyan) kehte hain, aur ek sternum. Sternum (seene ki haddi) seene ke beech mein ek lambi chapti haddi hai. Pasliyan peechhe ki taraf thoracic vertebrae se jurti hain. Aage ki taraf 7 jore pasliyan alag alag costal cartilages ke zariye seedhe sternum se jurti hain; inhen true ribs kehte hain. 8th, 9th aur 10th jore ek mushtarka (common) costal cartilage ke zariye sternum se jurte hain; inhen false ribs kehte hain. Aakhri 2 jore (11th aur 12th) floating ribs kehlate hain kyun ke yeh sternum se nahin jurte.

blocks.alt: S ki shakal mein mura hua vertebral column pehlu se, har hissa apne rang mein aur bracket ke saath: Cervical (7), Thoracic (12), Lumbar (5), Sacral (5 jure hue) aur Coccygeal (4 jure hue). Pehle do vertebrae Atlas aur Axis likhe hain; vertebrae ke darmiyan intervertebral disc hai, aur un ke peechhe spinal cord chalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.8: Reerh ki haddi (vertebral column) (kitab ki Figure 12.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gin kar dekhein: 7 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar; sacral aur coccygeal vertebrae aapas mein jur kar ek ek haddi bana lete hain. Neeche ke vertebrae bare hain kyunke un par zyada wazan hai. Discs jhatke jazb karti hain, aur S jaisa khum do-paya chalne mein tawazun deta hai.

blocks.alt: Pasliyon ka pinjra saamne se: thoracic vertebrae se nikalti 1 se 12 tak gini hui baarah jore pasliyan, beech mein sternum aur pasliyon ko us se jorne wali costal cartilage. 1 se 7 true ribs hain jo apni cartilage se sternum se juri hain; 8 se 10 false ribs hain jo pasli 7 ki cartilage ke zariye juri hain; 11 aur 12 floating ribs hain jin ke agle sire azad hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.9: Pasliyon ka pinjra (rib cage) (kitab ki Figure 12.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rang se qismein pehchanein: narangi true ribs (seedha sternum se), zaitooni false ribs (sternum tak baalwasta), aur surmai floating ribs (aage se kisi se nahin juri). Safed hisse costal cartilage hain jo pinjre ko saans ke waqt lachak dete hain.
Appendicular skeleton
Appendicular skeleton mein jism ke appendages (bazu aur taangen) ki haddiyan shamil hain: pectoral girdle, pelvic girdle, forelimbs (bazu) aur hindlimbs (taangen).

a- Pectoral girdle (kandhe ka halqa): is mein 2 jore hain: clavicles (hansli ki haddiyan) ka ek jora aur scapulae (kandhe ki haddiyan) ka ek jora. Har clavicle ka ek sira sternum se aur doosra sira scapula se jurta hai.
b- Forelimbs: har forelimb (bazu, kalai, haath, ungliyan) mein yeh 30 haddiyan hain.

items: Ek humerus: yeh lambi haddi hai; is ke sire par gol sar (spherical head) hai jo glenoid cavity (kandhe ka khaancha) mein fit hota hai.
Ek ulna aur ek radius: yeh lambi haddiyan hain. Ulna bazu ke andar ki taraf aur radius bahar ki taraf (angoothe wali taraf) hai. Ulna radius se thori bari hai.
Aath carpals: yeh chhoti haddiyan do qataron mein hain aur kalai banati hain. Oopar wali qatar radius se jur kar kalai ka jor banati hai.
Paanch metacarpals: yeh haddiyan hatheli banati hain.
Chaudah phalanges: har ungli mein 3 phalanges aur angoothe mein 2 phalanges hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab “carpels” likhti hai. Kalai ki aath haddiyon ka sahi naam carpals hai; carpels phool ke hisse hote hain.

c- Pelvic girdle (koolhe ka halqa): yeh do hip bones (koolhe ki haddiyon) se bana hai. Har hip bone teen haddiyon se bani hai: ilium, ischium aur pubis. Har hip bone mein ek haddi ka khaancha (socket) hai jise acetabulum kehte hain; yeh teenon haddiyon ke jurne se banta hai. Dono hip bones aage ki taraf pubic symphysis se jure hain (yeh ek cartilaginous jor hai jo jism ki beech wali lakeer par pubic haddiyon ko jorta hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab koolhe ki haddi ka naam “ileum” likhti hai. Sahi naam ilium hai. Ileum chhoti aant ka aakhri hissa hai, haddi nahin.
d- Hindlimbs: har hindlimb (taang, takhna, paon, ungliyan) mein 30 haddiyan hain.

items: Ek femur: raan ki lambi haddi. Is ka sar pelvic girdle ke acetabulum mein fit hota hai.
Ek patella ya kneecap (ghutne ki chapni): yeh ek lambe tendon mein dhansi hoti hai jo ghutne ke jor ke oopar se guzarta hai.
Ek tibia aur ek fibula: tibia (pindli ki haddi) taang ki bari haddi hai. Fibula (bahar wali haddi) patli haddi hai jo ghutne ke jor ke zara neeche aur takhne ke zara oopar tibia se jurti hai.
Saat tarsals: yeh chhoti haddiyan hain jo mazbooti se jur kar takhna banati hain.
Paanch metatarsals: yeh tarsals aur phalanges se jur kar paon ka talwa banati hain.
Chaudah phalanges: har ungli mein 3 phalanges aur bare angoothe mein 2 phalanges hain.

blocks.text: Jor (Joints)

Jor (joint) woh jagah hai jahan do haddiyan, ya haddi aur cartilage, aapas mein milti hain. Insani jism mein teen bari qism ke jor hain: fibrous (na hilne wale) jor, cartilaginous (thora hilne wale) jor aur synovial (azadi se hilne wale) jor (Figure 12.10-a).
1- Fibrous joints
Fibrous joints mein haddiyan fibrous connective tissue se seedhi juri hoti hain jo zyada tar collagen ka bana hota hai. Yeh jor haddiyon ko bilkul hilne nahin dete. Fibrous joints ki misalen:

items: Sutures (silaiyan), jo sirf khopri ki na hilne wali haddiyon ke beech hoti hain.
Nichli taang mein tibia aur fibula ke beech ke jor.
Jabre ki haddi mein daanton aur un ke khanon (sockets) ke beech ke jor.

blocks.text: 2- Cartilaginous joints
In joron mein haddiyan cartilage ki ek tah se juri hoti hain. Cartilaginous joints haddiyon ko thora sa hilne dete hain. In ki do bari qismein hain:

items: Kuch cartilaginous joints mein haddiyan hyaline cartilage se juri hoti hain, maslan pehli pasli aur sternum ka jor.
Kuch cartilaginous joints mein haddiyan fibrocartilage se juri hoti hain, maslan pelvic girdle ki pubic symphysis aur intervertebral discs.

blocks.text: 3- Synovial joints

Synovial joints insani jism mein sab se zyada paye jane wale jor hain aur yeh bohat zyada harkat dete hain. Jor mein haddiyon ke siron par ek chikni, sakht aur lachakdar hyaline cartilage hoti hai jise articular cartilage kehte hain. Yeh harkat ke liye chikni aur bina ragar (frictionless) satah deti hai. Synovial joint ke gird ek fibrous capsule hota hai jo haddiyon ko aapas mein jore rakhne mein madad deta hai. Fibrous capsule ki bahar wali tah ligaments ki hai aur andar synovial membrane ki parat hai, jo synovial fluid nikalti hai; yeh fluid jor ko chikna rakhta hai. Jor mein haddiyon ko jorne wali connective tissue ki mazboot pattiyon ko ligaments kehte hain.
Harkat ki had (range of motion) ke lihaz se synovial joints ki chhe bari qismein hain:

items: Ball-and-socket joints har simt mein harkat dete hain, maslan kandhe aur koolhe ke jor.
Hinge joints sirf ek satah (plane) mein harkat dete hain, darwaze ke qabze ki tarah, maslan kohni aur ghutne ke jor.
Pivot joints ek mehwar (axis) ke gird ghoomne dete hain, maslan gardan ke pehle aur doosre vertebra ka jor.
Ellipsoidal joints do satahon mein harkat dete hain lekin ghoomne nahin dete, maslan kalai ka radius ke saath jor.
Saddle joints do satahon mein harkat dete hain, kyun ke ek haddi ki satah andar ko dabi (concave) aur doosri ki bahar ko ubhri (convex) hoti hai, maslan angoothe ka jor.
Gliding joints haddiyon ko ek doosre par phisalne (glide) dete hain, maslan vertebrae ke beech ke jor aur kalai aur takhne ki haddiyon ke beech ke jor.

blocks.title: Joint Transplantation
blocks.text:
Joint transplantation ek operation hai jis mein kharab jor ko kisi donor ke sehatmand qudrati jor se ya masnooi (artificial) jor se badla jata hai. Is ki aam qismein:
Total joint replacement: poora kharab jor dhaat (metal), plastic ya ceramic ke masnooi jor se badla jata hai.
Partial joint replacement: sirf jor ka kharab hissa masnooi purze se badla jata hai; aksar ghutne mein.
Allograft transplantation: donor ka sehatmand jor kharab jor ki jagah lagaya jata hai; aksar takhne aur ghutne mein.
Chondrocyte implantation: mareez ke apne jor se chondrocytes le kar kharab jor mein lagaye jate hain; aksar ghutne mein.

(b) Synovial jor: bone 1 aur bone 2 jin ke siron par articular cartilage hai, darmiyan synovial fluid, us ko gherti synovial membrane, bahar fibrous capsule aur us se bahar ligament.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) mein gulabi teer har jor ki harkat dikhate hain: ball and socket har simt, hinge sirf ek simt (darwaze ki tarah), pivot ghoomna, saddle do simt, ellipsoid do simt, gliding sirf sarakna. Fibrous aur cartilaginous jor bilkul ya taqreeban nahin hilte. (b) mein synovial jor ki tahein andar se bahar: cartilage, fluid, membrane, capsule, ligament.

blocks.title: Skeleton aur muscles do taangon par chalne mein madad karte hain
blocks.text:
Insan ka do taangon par seedha chalna (bipedal posture) skeleton aur muscles se kai tarah juda hai:
1. Insani reerh ki haddi mein khaas S jaisa kham (curve) hai, jo wazan barabar phailata hai aur khare hone aur chalne mein tawazun (balance) rakhta hai.
2. Insani pelvis chhoti aur chauri hai, jo dhar (torso) ko mazboot thamti hai aur jism ka wazan do taangon par sambhalti hai.
3. Insani femur ghutne ki taraf andar ko jhuka hua hai, jis se jism ka markaz-e-wazan (centre of mass) paon ke oopar rehta hai aur khare hone aur chalne mein thehrao milta hai.
4. Koolhon (buttocks) ke muscles insanon mein bohat bare hote hain; yeh dhar ko thame rakhte aur chalte waqt jism ko aage dhakelte hain.
5. Pindli (calf) ke muscles bhi insanon mein khoob bane hote hain aur chalne aur daurne ki taqat dete hain.
6. Insani paon mein lambai ke rukh ek mehrab (longitudinal arch) hoti hai jo jhatka jazb karti aur wazan poore paon par barabar phailati hai.
7. Paon ki ungliyan chhoti aur kam pakarne wali (less prehensile) hain, is liye chalne aur daurne mein paon lever ki tarah behtar kaam karta hai.

blocks.title: Ghalat posture ke masail
blocks.text:
Ghalat posture (baithne ya khare hone ka ghalat andaz) haddiyon aur joron ko nuqsan pohancha sakta hai:
Vertebral misalignment (vertebrae ka tarteeb se hatna): vertebrae aur nerves par dabao se kamar aur gardan ka dard aur herniated disc ho sakti hai.
Joint strain (joron par zor): gardan, kandhon, koolhon aur ghutnon par zor parta hai, jis se dard, sozish (inflammation) aur aage chal kar arthritis ho sakta hai.
Muscle imbalance: ghalat posture se kuch muscles zyada aur kuch kam istemal hote hain aur yeh haddiyon aur joron ko apni jagah se kheench sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Tooti hui femur chand mahinon mein jur jati hai, magar ghutne mein articular cartilage ka phata tukra shayad kabhi poori tarah theek na ho. Dono tissues ki banawat se farq samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Haddi ke Haversian canals aur periosteum mein khoon ki naliyan hain, aur zinda osteoblasts, osteocytes aur osteoclasts hain jo zindagi bhar use remodel karte hain, to yeh barh aur khud marammat kar sakti hai. Cartilage matrix mein khoon ki naliyan nahin; us ke lacunae mein chondrocytes ko sirf matrix se diffusion se ghiza milti hai, to is ki khud marammat ki salahiyat mehdood hai aur yeh bohat aahista theek hoti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Haddi: bahar periosteum; neeche compact bone (Haversian systems: lamellae, lacunae mein osteocytes, canaliculi, beech mein Haversian canal); andar spongy bone. Chaure sire epiphysis, beech ka hissa diaphysis.
Red marrow khoon ke cells banata hai; yellow marrow charbi ka zakhira hai. Osteoblasts haddi banate, osteocytes haddi qaim rakhte, osteoclasts haddi torte hain.
Lambi haddiyan cartilage se ossification ke zariye banti hain; khopri ki kuch haddiyan seedhi banti hain; remodelling saari zindagi chalti hai.
Cartilage: perichondrium, matrix mein khoon ki naliyan nahin, lacunae mein chondrocytes; hyaline (naak, trachea, jor), fibrocartilage (discs, pubic symphysis), elastic (kaan, epiglottis).
206 haddiyan. Axial: khopri 22, ossicles 6, hyoid, 33 vertebrae, 24 pasliyan aur sternum. Appendicular: pectoral girdle, har bazu 30, pelvic girdle (ilium, ischium, pubis), har taang 30.
Jor: fibrous (na hilne wale), cartilaginous (thora hilne wale), synovial (azad; chhe qismein: ball-and-socket, hinge, pivot, ellipsoidal, saddle, gliding).
